title: selenipedium × elsteadianum
intro: Selenipedium × elsteadianum, commonly known as Elstead's orchid, is a rare and hybrid species of orchid. It is a type of terrestrial orchid that is native to parts of Europe and Asia, known for its unique and striking appearance. The health benefits of Elstead's orchid include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been found to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
